zh-CN.title: 小程序广场阅读体验优化
items: 四个主页面的背景现已固定，滚动长列表时不再重复或漂移
底部导航改为不透明底色，广场中的合并聊天记录也会直接展开展示

en.title: Improved Square reading on the mini program
items: Backgrounds are now fixed across all four main tabs without repeating during long scrolls
The bottom navigation is now opaque, and merged chat records expand directly inside Square posts
